title: enhance-observability-and-rollback-safety-for-unified-rollouts
author: Maya Chen
description:
Motivation: We frequently see noisy rollouts where regressions are detected late because rollout-level observability is limited. This PR adds richer rollout lifecycle telemetry, a timeline of rollout events, improved metric matching for automated rollback decisions, and safety guards to reduce false-positive autorollbacks.

Summary of changes: - Emit rollout lifecycle events (start, stage-complete, metric-check, rollback-triggered, rollback-complete) to telemetry with context (rollout_id, model_version, cohort). - Add rollout-level aggregated metrics: rollout_error_rate, rollout_latency_p50/p90, rollout_model_mismatch_rate. - Improve metric matching logic in the rollout controller to use both absolute and relative thresholds and to require sustained violations (windowed checks). - Add a configurable cooldown and min-sample checks before autorollback triggers. - Surface a rollout timeline in Console with links to trace spans and per-cohort metrics. - New Grafana dashboard and SLO/alert rules for rollout regressions. - E2E tests for canary / A/B / shadow workflows and autorollback stability guards. - Documentation updates and release notes.

Checklist: - [x] telemetry events and metrics implemented - [x] rollout controller safety guards implemented - [x] Console timeline UI and linking to traces - [x] Grafana dashboard provisioning - [x] E2E acceptance tests - [x] Performance microbenchmarks (controller overhead < 3%)

Rollout plan: Gradual rollout of the new controller logic behind a feature flag. Start with internal and a subset of Dedicated customers (beta). Monitor rollout_error_rate and autorollback_rate; canary the Console UI via feature flags.

No breaking API changes: rollout CRD schema has additive optional fields for metric matching and cooldowns. Existing rollouts default to previous behavior unless new fields or feature flag enabled.

Related: ENG-4821 (rollout observability), PM-9012 (product acceptance criteria).
commits: rollout: emit lifecycle events and context (rollout_id, model_version)
telemetry: add rollout metrics and aggregation hooks
controller: implement sustained-violation detection and cooldown before autorollback
console: rollout timeline view and trace linking
dashboards: add rollout health Grafana dashboard and alerts
tests: add e2e scenarios for canary/ab/shadow + autorollback stability tests
docs: rollout observability and safety guide
perf: microbenchmarks and controller overhead optimizations
review_comments: Diego Alvarez: Overall looks good, big +1. A few nits: can we avoid emitting high-cardinality tags on every request? Suggest rollup by cohort and sample IDs.
Maya Chen: Thanks Diego — switched event payloads to remove user/session IDs and only include cohort/model_version; added sampling on debug mode.
Liam O'Connor: The sustained-violation window default is 3 minutes; how did we pick that? Can we make it configurable per-rollout?
Maya Chen: Made window and cooldown configurable via rollout spec (optional fields) and added defaults that match product guidance. Added notes in docs.
Sara Patel: Added UI comments: timeline should link to trace and show metric sparkline per stage. Also check accessibility on new timeline component.
Maya Chen: Timeline includes trace link, small sparkline, and keyboard focus states. Wrote unit tests for Timeline keyboard interactions.
Liam O'Connor: CI flaky e2e failure reproduced locally (shadow path). Traced to race in test harness; fixed with deterministic seeding.
Maya Chen: Fixed e2e harness race and re-ran pipeline. All checks green.
release_notes: Enhancement: Improved rollout observability (lifecycle events, rollout-level metrics, Console timeline), and increased safety for automated rollback (sustained-violation windows, cooldowns, min-sample checks). No breaking changes. Enable via feature flag or new rollout spec fields.
risk_assessment: Medium: changes are behind feature flags and additive to rollout spec. Autorollback logic tightened (reduces false positives). E2E coverage added; recommend beta on Dedicated customers before full rollout.
testing_summary: Added unit tests for metric matcher and autorollback guards, integration tests for telemetry emission, and e2e scenarios covering canary, A/B and shadow rollouts. Performance microbenchmarks show <3% CPU overhead on controller.
notes_for_ops: When enabling feature flag, watch new metrics rollout_error_rate, autorollback_rate, and rollout_controller_cpu. Alerting added to Grafana; ops should validate trace links for first rollouts.
migration_notes: No migration required. New optional fields in rollout spec are ignored by older controllers. To opt-in, add metric_matching and cooldown sections to rollout manifests or enable the feature flag.
acknowledgements: Thanks to SRE for alert tuning and Observability team for dashboard guidance.
